caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: The bar chart titled “Humour” illustrates GEMBA-SQM humour scores for four prompt variants labeled V1 through V4. The horizontal axis contains the categorical versions in left-to-right order V1, V2, V3, and V4, with no additional axis label shown. The vertical axis represents the GEMBA-SQM score on a linear scale ranging from 60.0 to 80.0, with regularly spaced tick marks at 2.5-point intervals (e.g., 60.0, 62.5, 65.0, …, 80.0). There are four single (non-stacked, non-grouped) bars: V1 is shown in blue with an annotated value of 71.4; V2 is orange with an annotated value of 68.5; V3 is green with an annotated value of 71.9; and V4 is purple with an annotated value of 68.15. The chart includes dashed horizontal gridlines, the bars are not visually emphasized beyond their distinct colors, and the categories do not appear to be sorted by value.
